question: After the mechanical repair, should maintainers capture real behavior proof for this ClawSweeper-authored forward-port head, apply a proof override, or pause/close the replacement?
rationale: The existing bot status comment explicitly leaves proof capture or override to maintainer intent, and this read-only review cannot supply release-gate proof for the repaired bot branch.

options.title: Repair then capture proof
options.body: Fold the duplicate type, rebase and refresh generated outputs, rerun focused checks, then attach or link proof for the repaired head before merge.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer may waive the proof gate after reviewing the repair and accepting the release-forward-port risk.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: If the forward-port is no longer worth carrying, leave the branch blocked or close it instead of spending repair effort.

recommendation.title: Repair then capture proof
recommendation.body: Fold the duplicate type, rebase and refresh generated outputs, rerun focused checks, then attach or link proof for the repaired head before merge.
